title: Aqua
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In the 24th century, terraformed Mars is an ocean world called Aqua. Akari Mizunashi arrives in Neo-Venezia, a replica of Venice, to train with Aria Company as an apprentice gondolier guide, an Undine. Each chapter is a calm slice-of-life episode of her training, her mentor Alicia and her friends from rival companies; this two-volume prequel leads into Aria.
life_message: A good life is found in wonder at ordinary days, patient work at a craft and kindness to everyone you meet.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: No feuds; gentle teasing is the only conflict (Wikipedia).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Structured ranks Pair, Single, Prima, but free exploration of the city.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Friendships across rival companies and kindness to strangers like the mailman.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Apprentice ranks and respect for mentor Alicia.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: High-tech terraformed future preserving old Venetian ways.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Quality of life, beauty and calm valued over striving.

folkways.japan: The iyashikei healing mood, mono no aware (MangaUpdates) and senpai-kohai mentorship reflect Japanese conventions.

delivery.evidence: Wikipedia: praised for calm pacing and optimism; an anime reviewer contrasted it with 'moralizing' uplifting stories.
delivery.note: The values come through atmosphere and episodes, not argument.

winners_losers: No losers; Akari and her friends progress in their craft and friendships.
